'''EN-4C''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that was part of the [[Cademimu V]] police force during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], it was [[Cademimu uprising|destroyed]] by a strike team seeking to disable the Cademimu missile stockpiles.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
EN-4C appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the "Cademimu" flashpoint.
